teaser.en: Children on the coast know this spiny bush for its small black berries, sweet enough to be worth a scratch or two.
teaser.sw: Watoto wa pwani wanakijua kichaka hiki chenye miiba kwa matunda yake madogo meusi, matamu kiasi cha kustahili mkwaruzo mmoja au miwili.

summary.en: *Mtambuu* is the carissa or num-num, a spiny shrub of the coastal bush with small, sweet black berries. It is picked as a wild fruit and used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mtambuu* ni mtandamboo (carissa au num-num), kichaka chenye miiba cha vichaka vya pwani, chenye matunda madogo meusi yaliyo matamu. Huchumwa kama tunda la porini na hutumika katika dawa.

about.en:
*Mtambuu* is a dense, spiny shrub. Its branches carry sharp, straight thorns, and the small, glossy leaves sit in opposite pairs. Like its relatives in the family Apocynaceae, it bleeds a white milky sap when broken.

The white, star-shaped flowers are fragrant. They are followed by small round berries that ripen from red to purple-black and are sweet when ripe.
about.sw:
*Mtambuu* ni kichaka kizito chenye miiba. Matawi yake yana miiba mikali iliyonyooka, na majani yake madogo yanayong'aa hukaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana. Kama jamaa zake wa familia ya Apocynaceae, hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa unapovunjwa.

Maua yake meupe yenye umbo la nyota yana harufu nzuri. Baada yake huja matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva kutoka rangi nyekundu hadi zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi, na huwa matamu yakiiva.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket across the south coast, often on the edges of farms and along footpaths.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na misitu minene ya pwani kote pwani ya kusini, mara nyingi pembezoni mwa mashamba na kando ya vijia.

uses.en: The ripe berries are gathered and eaten as a wild fruit. The plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda yaliyoiva huchumwa na kuliwa kama tunda la porini. Mmea huu pia hutumika katika dawa.

names.en: In Digo the shrub is *mtambuu*. Swahili uses *mtambuu* or *mtandamboo*, and Mgombato also gives *mtantamboo*. In Chonyi it is *mtandamboo*. In English it is carissa or num-num, and its scientific name is given as both *Carissa spinarum* and the older *C. edulis*. The same Digo name, *mtambuu*, is also recorded for the closely related conkerberry.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo kichaka hiki ni *mtambuu*. Kiswahili hutumia *mtambuu* au *mtandamboo*, na Mgombato pia inatoa *mtantamboo*. Kwa Kichonyi ni *mtandamboo*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *carissa* au *num-num*, na jina lake la kisayansi hutolewa kama *Carissa spinarum* na pia jina la zamani *C. edulis*. Jina hilo hilo la Kidigo, *mtambuu*, pia limerekodiwa kwa mmea wa karibu sana uitwao *conkerberry*.
